summary: Completed comprehensive testing of On-Demand Affiliate & Reseller Link Generation System. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. The new scalable system correctly generates links per-product on-demand instead of bulk loading.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On-demand affiliate/reseller link system fully tested. User admin@pigma.com is approved as both affiliate and reseller. New collections: affiliate_links, reseller_links. Old bulk endpoints /api/affiliates/product-links and /api/resellers/products have been REMOVED (return 404). Link structures verified: affiliate=?aff_id=USER_ID, reseller=?reseller_id=USER_ID&price=CUSTOM_PRICE. Dashboards are lightweight with My Links + Find Products tabs - NO bulk product loading.
